title: Dodgers beat Braves to advance in MLB playoffs, Rays oust Yankees
summary: The World Series champion Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Atlanta Braves, 4-1, to advance in the Major League Baseball Playoffs on Wednesday as the Tampa Bay Rays ousted the New York Yankees.
